title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Tuesday 24 November, 1:53pm.** The three standouts right now: the **AirPods Pro 3 at £165** at Amazon (still their lowest ever), the award-winning **TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED TV at £699** at Amazon (£150 off) and the **Apple Watch Ultra 3 at £495** at Argos (over £250 off, very rare for Apple).

Black Friday is three days away, on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This afternoon we added the TCL P8L TV, the Sony PS-LX3BT turntable at £199 and the Lego Neuschwanstein Castle at £189.99, all at Amazon. To make room we took off the Mac mini, the Apple Watch Series 11 and the iPad Air, which were only modest discounts. **PS5 buyers:** consoles are in short supply since GTA VI launched, but a DualSense controller is £42.99 at Amazon; see our [PS5 guide](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/) before paying a reseller's price. Prices were reported on 23 and 24 November, so check the retailer's page before you buy. Many Amazon prices need Prime: a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale.

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: Still £165 at Amazon on 24 November (T3) and 23 November (Macworld): the lowest UK price yet. The AirPods most people should buy.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs, still £39.99 this morning (22 November). The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is still excellent. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/). Re-confirmed on 23 November (afternoon).

deals.name: JBL Live 780NC Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
deals.note: A new low of £99 at Amazon on 23 November (What Hi-Fi), £71 off. Big, comfortable over-ears with decent noise cancelling for well under half the price of a Sony or Bose.

deals.name: TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED 4K TV
deals.note: £150 off at Amazon (What Hi-Fi, 24 November), and a What Hi-Fi? Award winner this year. Mini LED brightness for under £700 is the best-value big TV deal we've seen this week.

deals.name: Apple Watch Ultra 3 (49mm, Ocean Band)
deals.note: Over £250 off at Argos (TechRadar, 23 November), a rare cut for Apple's top watch. Amazon isn't matching it yet, so Argos is the one to use. Still £495 at Argos on 23 November (TechRadar). Amazon doesn't match it yet; use the compare link to check.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Colorsoft (16GB)
deals.note: Amazon's colour-screen Kindle, great for comics, cookbooks and highlighting. TechRadar lists it at £144.99 today, and Which?'s price data puts that at its cheapest ever. A [Kindle Unlimited trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) adds free books. See our [Kindle guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. Still £139.99 in TechRadar's Amazon picks today (22 November), the lowest price it has been. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Ember 75-inch TV
deals.note: 40% off at Amazon (T3, 23 November). A lot of screen for under £1,000, with Fire TV built in. Fine for films and sport; serious gamers should look at the TV guide.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's cheapest current cordless at £130 off, still in Amazon's Black Friday picks this morning (20 November). Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/). Re-confirmed on 23 November (afternoon).

deals.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones
deals.note: About £150 off at Amazon (T3, 23 November). Bose's best noise cancelling; pick these over the Sony XM5 if comfort on long flights matters most.

deals.name: Sonos Ace Noise Cancelling Headphones
deals.note: Sonos' over-ear headphones with strong noise cancelling that can also take over your Sonos soundbar's audio. Still £150 off at Amazon in TechRadar's picks today (22 November), well under the £279 to £299 they usually sell for. See our [AirPods guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) if you prefer Apple.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L Air Fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families buy. It was £125 to £128 last Black Friday, so this already beats it. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 Electric Toothbrush
deals.note: Philips' premium sonic brush with app tracking and a charging glass. TechRadar reports £109.99 at Amazon today, a record low. See our [Oral-B guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) if you prefer a rotating head.

deals.name: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene Wet Floor Cleaner
deals.note: The cheapest it has been, according to TechRadar on 22 November. A hard-floor wet cleaner for kitchens and bathrooms, not a vacuum replacement for carpets.

deals.name: Sony PS-LX3BT Bluetooth Turntable
deals.note: £100 off at Amazon (What Hi-Fi, 24 November). Plays records through Bluetooth speakers or headphones as well as a normal hi-fi, so it's an easy Christmas present for a new vinyl fan.

deals.name: Apple Pencil Pro
deals.note: £33 off at Amazon (Macworld, 23 November). Works with recent iPad Air, iPad Pro and iPad mini models only, so check yours first.

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4-Series 4K TV
deals.note: A record low, re-confirmed by TechRadar on 22 November. A simple 4K TV with Fire TV built in: good for a bedroom or second room, not a home-cinema set.

deals.name: Apple AirTag (2nd gen) 4-pack
deals.note: £18.50 a tag (Macworld, prices checked 23 November), a little up on the weekend's £71.78 but still £25 off. An easy stocking filler for keys, bags and suitcases.

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm)
deals.note: £484.99 at Amazon on 23 November (T3), £215 off and within a few pounds of the lowest price we've seen (£479.99 this morning). Prices on this one have moved several times this week, so check before you buy.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: Blink Outdoor 4 Camera + free Blink Mini 2K+
deals.note: A battery-powered outdoor camera plus an indoor plug-in camera for £24.99 (TechRadar, 21 November). Saving clips needs a Blink subscription or a Sync Module with a USB stick. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M5, 16GB, 512GB)
deals.note: £150 off at Amazon (Macworld, 23 November), cheaper than John Lewis's £1,199. The 512GB storage is worth having on a laptop you'll keep for years.

deals.name: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless Headphones
deals.note: Back to their lowest price, £25 at Amazon on 23 November (What Hi-Fi). No noise cancelling, but 50-hour battery and light enough for kids or the commute. An easy stocking filler.

deals.name: LEGO Neuschwanstein Castle (3,455 pieces)
deals.note: 21% off at Amazon (T3, 23 November). A big display build for adult Lego fans; a good main present for someone who has everything.

deals.name: LEGO Classic Large Creative Brick Box (10698)
deals.note: 790 mixed bricks in a storage box, a gift that suits almost any age from 4 up. £28.99 in TechRadar's Amazon picks today (22 November). More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Tech

The best tech deals right now are on Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature at £139.99, the Kindle Colorsoft at its lowest-ever £144.99, the Ring doorbell bundle at £39.99 and a Blink Outdoor 4 camera with a free Blink Mini for £24.99. The Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm) is £484.99, a few pounds above its low. For Apple, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 is £495 at Argos (over £250 off), a 4-pack of AirTags is £74, the Apple Pencil Pro is £96 and the MacBook Air M5 (512GB) is £1,148.97 at Amazon. The AirPods Pro 3 are still at their lowest-ever £165 at Amazon, and the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case are £119.

For audio, the JBL Live 780NC are a record-low £99, the Bose QuietComfort Ultra are £298.79, the Sonos Ace are £199 and Sony's WH-CH520 are £25 for a cheap commuting or kids' pair. Sony's PS-LX3BT Bluetooth turntable is £100 off at £199. For TVs, the TCL P8L 65-inch Mini LED is £699 (a What Hi-Fi? Award winner), the Amazon Ember 50-inch is a record-low £269.99 and the Ember 75-inch is £959. PS5 consoles are hard to find at the normal price, but controllers are cheap: a DualSense is £42.99 at Amazon.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Apple Watch](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

Ninja's air fryers are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices: the AF300UK dual-zone is £119.99 and the Crispi glass air fryer £99. The Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 (Amazon) is the standout cordless vacuum deal, the Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene floor cleaner is its cheapest yet at £259. The Sage Bambino Plus is £349 at Amazon, but that isn't its lowest ever, so it's not on the list.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

Electric toothbrushes are the best beauty deals today: the Philips Sonicare DiamondClean 9000 is a record-low £109.99 at Amazon. For fragrance gifts, Superdrug's Black Friday event runs until 1 December, and Amazon sells most of the same sets, so [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. The Lego Classic Large Creative Brick Box is £28.99 at Amazon, an easy gift for almost any age, and for adult Lego fans the 3,455-piece Neuschwanstein Castle is £189.99 (21% off). For readers, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December and can be given as a gift. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [PS5](/guides/ps5-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
